start.title: The Fork in the Road
start.text: You awaken beneath towering pines, with no memory of how you arrived. Mist curls around your boots. Ahead, the path splits: a lantern glows to the left, while a low growl echoes from the right.

choices.text: Follow the lantern toward a cabin
Investigate the growl near the cave

cabin.title: The Abandoned Cabin
cabin.text: The cabin door swings open at your touch. A brass key rests on a dusty table, beside a letter addressed to you. Somewhere upstairs, a floorboard creaks.

cave.title: The Echoing Cave
cave.text: Inside the cave, the growl fades. A small wolf is trapped beneath a fallen branch. Beyond it, an eerie blue light pulses deep in the darkness.

letter.title: A Warning from Yourself
letter.text: The letter is written in your own handwriting: 'Do not trust the light.' As you finish reading, you remember everything. You came here to stop something from waking. For now, you have survived—but the mystery remains.

stairs.title: The Watcher Upstairs
stairs.text: At the top of the stairs, you find a mirror. Your reflection smiles before you do. The cabin doors slam shut, and the forest falls silent. Your adventure ends here.

wolf.title: A Loyal Companion
wolf.text: You lift the branch and free the wolf. It leads you through a hidden passage to the edge of the forest. At dawn, you reach safety, and your new companion disappears into the trees.

crystal.title: The Heart of the Forest
crystal.text: You touch the glowing crystal. The entire cave shudders, and the forest outside begins to bloom. You have awakened an ancient power. Whether that was wise is a story for another day.

cellar.title: The Hidden Cellar
cellar.text: Your brass key turns in the cellar lock. Behind the door, a lantern burns beside an ancient map. You have found a safer way through the forest.

choices.text: Take the map and return to the forest

cellar_end.title: A Safe Refuge
cellar_end.text: You wait until dawn in the hidden cellar. The forest grows quiet, and you emerge with a new understanding of its secrets.
